description: This file defines the DayOfWeekField class, which extends AbstractField, and handles parsing and evaluating day-of-week expressions for scheduling purposes, including special tokens like 'L' for last, '#' for nth occurrence, and literals for days.

classes.name: DayOfWeekField
classes.description: A class for handling day-of-week scheduling expressions, including special tokens and validation.

methods.name: isSatisfiedBy
methods.description: Checks if a given date satisfies the day-of-week expression value.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Moves the date forward or backward by one day, adjusting time accordingly.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the syntax of a day-of-week expression.

methods.name: convertLiterals
methods.description: Converts day-of-week literals (SUN, MON, etc.) to numeric values.
